remarks: Lives Like a Townhouse - Spacious, Sunny & Conveniently Located  Enjoy the comfort and privacy of townhouse-style living in this bright and spacious four-bedroom rental just 0.7 miles from the New Canaan Metro-North station and close to town, schools, shopping, and dining. The versatile floor plan offers generous living spaces, including a formal Living Room (or Home Office), Dining Room, and a welcoming Family Room with a fireplace. The spacious Primary Suite features its own fireplace, private balcony, and en-suite bath, creating a comfortable retreat at the end of the day. Additional highlights include a private deck for outdoor enjoyment, an attached garage, and exceptional storage space with a walk-up attic. Tenant is responsible for utilities. Lawn care, snow removal, and trash service are shared with the neighboring unit (#41). No smoking. Good credit and strong references required.
